Pat Quinn, teenager in ~1952. Child of John Joseph Quinn and Marie Ellinghaus Quinn.
Pat Quinn, a teenager in about 1952; daughter of John Joseph Quinn and Marie Ellinghaus Quinn. Barbara calls her "Aunt Pat".
Born 28 Sep 1940 in Baltimore; died 21 Nov 2009 in Baltimore (Quinn Family Tree on Ancestry). Her husband Walter G. Revty (1938–2006) died 19 Dec 2006.
Her obituary names her children Christopher, Patrick and Kelly Gilden (by an earlier marriage to a Gilden), Amanda Revty and the late Mark Revty, and her stepdaughter Sharon Helmly.
